title: Anti-AI in the Wild: From Toxic Discourse to Action
abstract: arXiv:2611.33254v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online discussion of generative AI has become increasingly contentious, and communities devoted to supporting, opposing, or debating AI have emerged on social media. Some of these communities take anti-AI actions, such as deploying crawler tarpits and data-poisoning services to interfere with data collection and model training. Yet, the scope of these actions and their relationship to online discourse remain poorly understood. In this paper, we present the first measurement study of online conflict over generative AI, from toxic discourse to anti-AI actions. We collect 931,640 posts from 25 Reddit communities, label them with a large language model detector validated against human labels, identify 3,312 anti-AI actions, and trace the output of three deployed anti-AI tools. translated_title: 现实世界中的反AI：从毒性言论到实际行动
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33254v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：关于生成式AI的在线讨论变得日益充满争议，社交媒体上出现了致力于支持、反对或辩论AI的社区。其中一些社区会采取反AI行动，例如部署爬虫蜜罐和数据污染服务来干扰数据收集和模型训练。然而，这些行动的范围及其与在线言论之间的关系仍然鲜为人知。在本文中，我们首次对生成式AI相关的在线冲突进行了测量研究，涵盖从毒性言论到反AI行动的全过程。我们从25个Reddit社区收集了931,640条帖子，使用经过人工标注验证的大语言模型检测器对其进行标注，识别出3,312个反AI行动，并追踪了三个已部署的反AI工具的输出。我们的分析显示，在专门讨论这一冲突的社区中，30.0%的帖子具有毒性，而一般AI社区中这一比例仅为4.4%。这些社区中的反AI行动……
tldr: 本文首次对生成式AI的在线冲突进行了大规模测量研究，通过分析93万余条Reddit帖子识别出反AI言论与实际行动，发现反AI社区的毒性帖子比例（30.0%）远高于一般AI社区（4.4%）。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first measurement study of online conflict over generative AI, analyzing 931,640 Reddit posts to identify toxic discourse and anti-AI actions, revealing that 30.0% of posts in dedicated communities are toxic compared to 4.4% in general AI communities.
